notes.title: Heart and Seoul Release & Soundtrack and Director's Commentary
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

We did it! Heart and Seoul is out! Now for those of you that follow our games you know that the soundtrack and director's commentary is usually available in a deluxe pack with the game but this time it's MISSING!

We just need to fix a few technical things and it will be available for purchase tomorrow, so if you know you like getting the soundtrack and director's commentary then PLEASE wait a day before buying Heart and Seoul.

For those of you that want to just get to it and play now, we completely understand and hope you enjoy the game too.

As usual thanks for listening and supporting us and keep being awesome!

The Sapphire Dragon Productions Team
